title: Buyer Onboarding Posture
description: How a buying agent considers sellers: a mode, the requirements a seller must meet, and where a seller's human starts. Published only in the buyer's trust.json: in the agent entry (agents[].profiles.adcp.onboarding), or as a record-level default (profiles.adcp.onboarding). Public and identical for every reader. mode uses the same enum as the seller's posture; here it says how the buyer considers sellers. See specs/agent-identity-3-3.md R7 (#8114).

requirements.description: What a seller must satisfy. Uses the kinds that apply when a buyer gates a seller (aao_verified, storyboard, sandbox, experimental_feature); others are ignored.

url.description: Where a seller's human starts. Untrusted: surface it, never fetch or execute it.

message.description: Human-readable summary; the fallback whenever a reader does not understand a requirement.
